projects.name: Kairo-Phantom
projects.summary: Local-first document automation with explicit human confirmation and Ed25519-signed, hash-chained action records, checked by a separately runnable verifier.
projects.boundary: Published results describe declared repository test surfaces; no certification or third-party validation exists.
projects.interaction: Confirm a harmless local action, issue a signed receipt, then alter one byte and watch verification fail.

projects.name: LedgerMatch
projects.summary: A local, review-first engine matching bank deposits to open invoices. It preserves ambiguity instead of silently choosing and emits a deterministic, tamper-evident evidence bundle.
projects.boundary: Deterministic matching on explicit input contracts; not an accounting system of record, and ambiguous allocations are never auto-accepted.
projects.interaction: Run the matcher on an ambiguous deposit and watch it refuse to guess; then record a human decision and see it chained into a tamper-evident review ledger.

projects.name: AccessDoc
projects.summary: Turns raw accessibility scan output into a tamper-evident evidence bundle — PDF report, OpenACR, SARIF, VPAT draft — with an attestation whose digests cover every file.
projects.boundary: Documents what a scan found with explicit coverage limits; automated tools detect only part of WCAG issues, so it never claims conformance.
projects.interaction: Build an evidence bundle, then alter one file and watch independent verification exit nonzero.
